title: Adaptive Microwave Reception with Diamond Spin Sensors
abstract: arXiv:2509.08171v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In a diamond-spin microwave receiver, pilot measurements can identify the spin-control phase that best separates binary phase-shift keyed symbols. Applying that phase takes time, during which carrier drift can erase the gain in alignment. We derive an exact feedback-delay threshold for a single payload spin from the phase information in the pilot record. On a finite menu of control phases, the pilot record enters the minimum-error update decision only through the direction of its first circular moment when that moment is nonzero. This result motivates a controller that estimates the direction from orthogonal pilot measurements and retains the existing phase whenever the predicted gain is lost to diffusion. For finite spin ensembles, we bound the distinguishability of the photon-count distributions in terms of optical readout and carrier-phase uncertainty, including fluctuations shared across spins. translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.08171v2 通告类型： replace-cross 摘要：在金刚石自旋微波接收机中，导频测量可以识别出最能区分二进制相移键控符号的自旋控制相位。应用该相位需要时间，而在此期间载波漂移可能会抹去对准所带来的增益。我们从导频记录中的相位信息推导出了单个有效载荷自旋的精确反馈延迟阈值。在有限的控制相位选项集合上，当一阶圆矩非零时，导频记录仅通过其一阶圆矩的方向进入最小误差更新决策。这一结果启发了一种控制器设计：该控制器从正交导频测量中估计该方向，并在预测增益因扩散而丧失时保留现有的相位。对于有限自旋系综，我们基于光学读出和载波相位不确定性（包括自旋间共享的涨落）对光子计数分布的可区分性进行了界定。在匹配条件下的分组仿真……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文推导了金刚石自旋微波接收机中反馈延迟的精确阈值，并据此提出了一种基于导频记录一阶圆矩方向估计的自适应相位控制器，从而在载波漂移条件下有效保持二进制相移键控符号的对准增益。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact feedback-delay threshold for diamond-spin microwave receivers and proposes an adaptive controller based on estimating the direction of the first circular moment from pilot measurements, maintaining phase-alignment gain under carrier drift.
